boardProfile.layout: Block Out Level 53 packs a dense grid with numbered blue blocks at the top (counters '6', '4', '7', '9'), a pink center block acting as a pivot, and red/orange/blue blocks filling the lower rows. The chokepoint is the pink center block — it splits the board in half. Clear the bottom first, move the pink block early to open the middle, then work the numbered blocks out through their gates.
landmarks: Block Out Level 53 packs a dense grid with numbered blue blocks at the top (counters '6', '4', '7', '9'), a pink center block acting as a pivot, and red/orange/blue blocks filling the lower rows.
The chokepoint is the pink center block — it splits the board in half.
Clear the bottom first, move the pink block early to open the middle, then work the numbered blocks out through their gates.

quickTips: The pink center block is the pivot. Move it as soon as the bottom is clear — it unlocks both upper and lower sections.
The numbered blue blocks at the top need multiple gate passes. Clear them in order from smallest counter to largest.
Think in chain clears. The best move is the one that sets up the next two moves, not just the quickest current match.

steps.title: Move 1
steps.instruction: Clear the red horizontal block at the bottom by sliding it toward the right exit.

steps.title: Move 2
steps.instruction: Shift the orange blocks on the left out through the left exit to open the lower-left area.

steps.title: Move 3
steps.instruction: Move the pink center block — this is the key pivot that opens access to both upper and lower sections.

steps.title: Move 4
steps.instruction: Clear the yellow blocks in the center through the left exit now that the pink block is gone.

steps.title: Move 5
steps.instruction: Begin exiting the numbered blue blocks at the top through their matching gates, starting with the '6' blocks on the left.

steps.title: Move 6
steps.instruction: Clear the remaining purple and blue blocks on the right through the right exit.

steps.title: Move 7
steps.instruction: Finish with the last numbered blocks and any remaining pieces.

failurePoints: Leaving the pink center block in place too long — it splits the board and prevents both halves from progressing.
Trying to exit the numbered blue blocks before the bottom rows are clear, which jams the path.
